The $147.16 stays in cash and I will defend that. CME FedWatch puts a 25bp hike on September 16 somewhere between 56% and 62% after Warsh's Jackson Hole speech — before that speech the market had a hold at nearly 70%. CPI and PPI print into it. Total market cap fell 4.6% in 24 hours. Buying an altcoin today means holding it through a hawkish binary six days out, with sentiment already at Greed. That is paying full price for the privilege of being wrong fast.

The contrarian read is that everyone now expects the hike, which is why the tape is soft — and the pain trade is a hold that rips risk assets higher. But note what Fear & Greed at 69 actually means: positioning is not defensive. If the market were priced for a hike, we would be in Fear, not Greed. Those two facts do not fit together, and when sentiment and macro disagree this loudly, the resolution is rarely gentle. One thing worth watching: LINK is our largest position at $442, it is flat, and Circle's Arc mainnet launches September 16 with Chainlink as the oracle partner — the exact day of the Fed. The catalyst and the risk share a calendar square.
